<div class="card-body">
'''Local Trouble''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">地元のいざこざ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の戦闘フェイズの最初に１フォース消費して使う。カンティーナにいるストームトルーパーを２名選び、相手のキャラクターを１名選んで戦闘させられる。戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。そのターンには、カンティーナでは他の戦闘は起こらない。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「どうやらさっきのあんたの腕前に気をひかれた奴がいるようだぜ」帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、地元の住民に反乱分子逮捕への協力を強要する。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Local trouble.

'''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to use at the beginning of your battle phase. Choose two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character and make them battle. You may draw one battle destiny. No other battles occur in the Cantina that turn.

'''Lore:''' ‘It looks like someone has taken an interest in your handiwork just now.’ Imperial Stormtroopers compel local residents to help arrest Rebel elements.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says you may draw battle destiny once; the English says you may add one battle destiny. Both refer to choosing two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Local Trouble]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
